text:
ella: Quick sync request. After the last round of auto-switches some customers asked for a way to "preview" what v2 would do for their traffic without actually flipping routing. Thinking: a dry-run preview that simulates routing & billing impact and shows a per-tenant estimate in console.

rohan: Love the idea. We already have request shadowing for canaries but it actually routes traffic. Preview should be zero-impact: run model selection logic on sampled historical requests and produce an estimate. No live routing.

samir: Telemetry-wise we can run the routing + model selection logic offline against the last N minutes of request logs and produce `dryrun_estimated_tokens` and `dryrun_estimated_cost` per tenant. Keep it async and cached for 15m.

ops-bot: note: previous incident 2025-11-30 showed customers confused because console toggles updated before telemetry caught up. Preview could help reduce surprises.

jess-product: UX: add a "Preview v2" action next to the flip toggle. Clicking opens modal: sample window (5/15/60m), sample rate slider (0.1%-5%), and an estimate panel: tokens delta, $ delta, likely drivers (warmup vs fallback). Include a recommended action list (safe-canary, cap seq-len, opt-out header).

li: Backend constraints: running offline analysis must be cheap. We should prioritize sampling historical requests rather than re-running all routing rules for full traffic. Proposal: sample 2% by default and extrapolate. Provide a checkbox for "high fidelity" to run 10% for bigger tenants.

rohan: Also provide an option to preview against different rollout strategies: full switch, safe-canary 5%, gradual ramp. Useful to compare.

samir: Implementation sketch: feed sampled request rows into a preview engine that applies v2 selection logic and computes: tokens_served_if_v2, tokens_served_if_v1, model_variant_mismatch_rate, kv_miss_rate, and sequence_len_hist. Output aggregated 1m buckets plus final estimate. Example query: 

```
WITH sample AS (
  SELECT * FROM request_log
  WHERE tenant_id = $T
  AND ts >= now() - interval '$WINDOW minutes'
  AND mod(hash(request_id), 10000) < $SAMPLE_THRESH
)
SELECT
  count(*) as sample_requests,
  sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE would_route_to_v2=true) as v2_tokens_sample,
  sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE would_route_to_v1=true) as v1_tokens_sample,
  avg(seq_len) as avg_seq
FROM sample;
```

jess-product: Nice. Console copy should surface uncertainty: show a confidence band (low/median/high) and a short explanation of sampling & assumptions. Avoid promising exact billing.

billing: Policy note: preview must include a clear disclaimers: "This is an estimate only. Actual billing is based on model served and real traffic." Also we need to track any requests where would_route_to_v2 would pick a more expensive variant; add an itemized example list customers can export for dispute support.

ella: Two more asks: 1) ability to opt the preview into simulated billing mode for a small cohort (records what would be billed vs charged but doesn't charge) so we can show concrete examples to customers; 2) telemetry tag `preview_run_id` so we can trace back aggregations to a preview run.

rohan: Good. We'll emit `preview_run_id`, `preview_strategy` (full/safe-canary/gradual), and `preview_sample_rate`. Keep cardinality low by not tagging every request — only aggregate outputs.

samir: To minimize storage, raw sample rows get TTL=2d. Aggregated preview results live for 15m by default. We can persist long-term only for simulated-billing canaries.

li: For safety controls: if preview shows >50% token delta or >$1000 estimated delta for any tenant, console should require a two-step confirmation (confirm + type tenant name). Also auto-suggest mitigations.

jess-product: UX: in the preview modal show a small "what to expect" checklist: warmup minutes estimate, fallback likelihood, recommended mitigations (safe-canary, cap seq-len, simulation billing). Include quick links to add support contact or schedule a migration window.

ops-bot: automation: create a bot action to run preview daily for tenants flagged for scheduled rollouts and post results to #migration-audit. Could help SEA/CS teams.

ella: Who owns preview engine? rohan for routing logic, samir for aggregator, console team for UI, billing for simulated billing infra.

rohan: I'll prototype the offline engine. Question: do we also want a "continuous preview" mode that runs on a sliding 15m window and updates estimates in near-real time? Might be heavy but useful for big tenants.

samir: We'll offer continuous preview as opt-in for flagged tenants and throttle frequency (once per 5m). Default is on-demand.

billing: One compliance note: any simulated billing data must be marked and accessible only to internal roles until legal approves sharing. Add a flag `sim_billing_confidential=true`.

li: Final thought: surface a small "preview score" metric in tenant summary: green/yellow/red based on estimated delta and fallback risk. Quick visual for CS.

jess-product: I'll mock the modal + preview panel and the three-state preview score. Will share in #product-design.

ella: Great. Action items: rohan -> spike preview engine & sample strategy; samir -> agg schema + preview_run_id; console -> modal + preview API; billing -> sim-billing feasibility + data access policy. I'll schedule a follow-up pre-roll call next Tue. Add blockers here. :rocket:
